name: atomic-rollout
description: A loader-agnostic check->warm->verify->promote->commit protocol for atomically rolling out a new version of a set of related resources (a remote micro-frontend entry, a Module Federation container, a native app update bundle) — so consumers never end up running a mix of old and new resources. Works alongside qiankun, Module Federation, wujie, a Service Worker, or a bare fetch; it does not replace any of them.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node ../../scripts/write-dual-pkg.mjs dist
